description: This PHP file defines the InstanceCreationHelper class within the OrangeHRM Installer Util namespace. It provides static data arrays for countries, languages, and time zone groups, along with helper methods to retrieve time zones and look up countries and languages by their codes. The class appears to facilitate setup or configuration tasks related to instance creation in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: InstanceCreationHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing static constants for country, language, and timezone data, along with methods to retrieve and look up timezone information and code-based lookups for countries and languages.

methods.name: getTimezones
methods.description: Returns an array of all available time zones with their identifiers as both id and label.

methods.name: getCountryByCode
methods.description: Takes a country code string and returns the corresponding country array with 'id' and 'label'.

methods.name: getLanguageByCode
methods.description: Takes a language code string and returns the corresponding language array with 'id' and 'label'.
